title: Dick Stabile's Onyx Club offer and the Silver Grill's counteroffer
summary: Stabile suggested the group follow Farley and Raleigh at the Onyx; the Silver Grill's manager offered to double salaries if they stayed in Buffalo, so Stuff went to New York to assemble another band.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Okay, Jonah. I think where we finished off you'd just said that the job had been offered at the Onyx, through Dick Stabile, that's right, wasn't it?
Yeah. He come back there. He come to Buffalo and we happened to be playing a place in Buffalo called the Silver Grill. Money was bad, but the people were nice and we --
No, not at the Silver Grill. This was before we got to New York.

Then Dick Stabile come to hear us and we Farley and Raleigh, who were in the Onyx at this time, they were getting ready to leave to go to California to make a picture, a moving picture, since they had just made a hit record called, 'You Blow Through Here,' 'The Music Goes Down and Around and Comes out There.' So they were leaving, so Dick Stabile told Stuff, 'This would be the very group to follow Farley and Raleigh in the Onyx Club.' So he said, 'We're going to have them come down and take a listen to you.' He said, 'Oh, good.' We didn't think it was going to happen, you

know. You have so many promises down through life. You get so it just goes in one ear and out the other. So, sure enough, they set it up. The guy come down to listen to us, and they said all right, on the 4th of February you open. Well, this is about December, or November, it could have been, the last part of November, the first part of December, and they were setting this up. So when we got ready to go to the Onyx, but then we kind of backed out, because the manager of the Onyx -- I mean the manager of the Silver Grill in Buffalo said, "Look, Jonah, let Stuff go ahead and get a band down there in New York and you all stay here and I'll raise you. I'll double your salaries if you all stay. You take the band and I'll double your salary. And when Stuff decides to come back, he's still got the job." So I said, yeah, it was a good idea, because you know, you're settled in and you're not particular about moving. And he did a lot of travelling about them different bands I told you about.
